summary: Rebuilds a scrollable profile-icon bitmap list: frees every existing linked-list item (optionally invoking the item's first vtable method), zeroes the list and layout state, enumerates BMP files in the profile icon directory, and for each entry builds a full path, strips the filename to its extension-less base name, loads the bitmap, allocates a UI widget, copies the path and base-name strings into it, and appends it to the list. Falls back to the default icon when a bitmap cannot be loaded. Recalculates the viewport layout and returns 0.

local_names.v2: linked-list head cursor, walked through node next-pointers
local_names.v4: flag: node byte at +12 is zero (skip vtable call)
local_names.v5: source directory string pointer, defaulting to byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC3F8 is null
local_names.v6: pointer difference used to copy the source string into v16
local_names.v7: character copied during the string copy
local_names.v9: entry filename portion after the last backslash
local_names.v10: cursor scanning the filename buffer for the extension dot
local_names.v11: loaded bitmap resource handle, null when the load fails
local_names.v12: raw allocation for the new UI widget
local_names.v13: constructed UI widget, null when allocation failed
local_names.v15: filename buffer with the extension stripped

operations.description: Call UIDimensionCapture() to record the UI dimensions before rebuilding the list.
Read the list head pointer from this+0xF0 (this[60]) into v2.
Walk the linked list while v2 is non-null; for each node read the byte at node+12 and capture the node next-pointer at node+4 into the new v2 before freeing.
If the node byte at +12 is non-zero and the node's vtable pointer (*v3) is non-null, invoke the first vtable method with argument 1 on the node.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3) to free each node.
Zero the list state: this[60] (0xF0), this[61] (0xF4), this[62] (0xF8), this[63] (0xFC) and the layout flag this[93] (0x174).
Write aProfileiconDft into the global lpExistingFileName; select the source string v5 as dword_5EC3F8, falling back to byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC3F8 is null.
Copy the selected source string character-by-character into the v16 path buffer until the NUL terminator is copied.
Call sub_565F80(aBmp_0, 1, v16, 1) to enumerate files matching the aBmp_0 pattern under the path in v16.
Call sub_566380(0) to reset the enumeration context.
Iterate directory entries: for each, set i = DirectoryEntryIterator(&unk_8AD3B0); loop while i is non-null, calling DirectoryEntryIterator again at each step.
Scan backward from the end of i to the last backslash (0x5C = 92) to isolate the filename portion v9.
Copy the filename into v15, then scan backward to the last dot (0x2E = 46) and replace it with a NUL terminator to strip the extension.
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v17, aSS, v16, v9) with the aSS format string ("%s%s") to build the full directory+filename path.
Call sub_497AD0(v17, 0) to load the bitmap for the full path; store the result in v11.
Branch into the create-item path when the bitmap load v11 is non-null.
Call OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(60) to allocate the widget, then UIObjectConstructor_fc50 on the result (or use a null widget when allocation failed).
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v17) to store the full path string into the widget.
Call StructFieldCopy_fc80(v11) to copy the loaded bitmap into the widget.
Call StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v15) to store the extension-less base name into the widget.
Call DoublyLinkedListAppend_f5d0(v13, 1) to append the new widget to the list.
On the else path (bitmap load failed), call sub_497AD0(aProfileiconDft, 0) to retry with the default profile icon.
Call LinkedListNodePeek(&unk_8AD3B0) to advance the directory enumeration.
After the loop, call sub_565EB0(&unk_8AD3B0) to reset the enumeration context.
Call UIViewportLayoutCalculator(this) to recompute the layout of the rebuilt list.
Return 0.

clean_pseudocode: if (v9 > i) { while (*v9 != '\\') if (--v9 <= i) break; ++v9; }
